aboutSubtitleTechnical: Your Voice. Your Truth. Protected by Design.
missionPara1: VocalWitness is a simple public square where anyone can share what they saw or experienced — with cryptographic proof that the content has not been changed after sealing.
missionPara2: In a world full of edited videos and noise, we give ordinary people a place to publish photos, voice notes, and reports. Media is fingerprinted on your device so the sealed version stays verifiable.

privacySec1Title: 1. Everything Important Happens on Your Device
privacySec1Para1: When you upload a photo, voice note, or document, the sensitive work is done inside your own browser before anything leaves your device:
privacySec1Bullet1: Metadata is removed: Camera model, GPS location, and other private details are automatically stripped.
privacySec1Bullet2: Digital fingerprint is created: Your browser makes a unique fingerprint of the file. Only this and the cleaned media are sent.
privacySec1Bullet3: Strong verification: You can prove you are a real person without revealing private identity details.
privacySec2Title: 2. What We Never Collect or Store
privacySec2Intro: For maximum safety we deliberately do not keep:
privacySec2Item1: Your real IP address — requests go through protection layers so your location is not linked to your posts.
privacySec2Item2: Phone numbers on any public record — phone checks are only temporary to stop spam and are never saved or shown.
privacySec2Item3: Government IDs, passports, biometrics, or your personal contact list.
privacySec3Title: 3. What We Do Process (Only What’s Needed)
privacyAccountInfoDesc: Your chosen username, security keys, and any trust badges you earn.
privacyContentDesc: Your reports, cleaned media, digital fingerprints, and timestamps.
privacyVerificationDesc: Proof that you are a real person — without revealing who you are.
privacyTechnicalDesc: Anonymous technical data used only to block attacks and bots.
privacySec4Text: Our design follows Articles 12 and 19 of the Universal Declaration of Human Rights: everyone has the right to privacy and the freedom to share information without interference.
privacySec5Text1: VocalWitness is only a technical host. We do not write, approve, or fact-check the content people post.
privacySec5Text2: Each person is fully responsible for what they choose to publish.
privacySec6Title: 6. What Is Not Allowed & How to Report
privacySec6Text1: Harassment, sharing someone’s private personal details without consent, child sexual abuse material, and deliberately fake harmful media are strictly forbidden.
privacySec6Text2: If you see content that breaks these rules, please report it using the in-app button.
privacySec7Text: You can clear local browser data with Quick Exit. Published reports are protected by application rules so ordinary users cannot edit or delete them. Operators and cloud infrastructure still control the underlying data.
privacySec8Text: The VocalWitness platform, including its software, design, name, and logo, is the exclusive intellectual property of VocalWitness. You may not copy or reuse it without permission.
termsIntro: Welcome to VocalWitness — a public square where people can share real reports and evidence with strong protection. By using the platform you agree to these simple rules.
termsSection1Text: By creating an account, posting, or using VocalWitness, you agree to these Terms and our Privacy Policy. If you do not agree, please do not use the platform.
termsSection2Title: 2. Our Role – A Neutral Public Square
termsSection2Text: VocalWitness is a neutral platform. We give people tools to publish reports and protect evidence. We are not a news publisher, we do not decide what is true, and we are not a court of law.
termsSection3Intro: To keep the square safe from bots and spam, we use simple levels of verification:
termsTier1: Open Talk — Open to everyone who signs up. Basic public discussion.
termsTier2: Citizen Circle — Unlocked with a temporary phone check (used only to stop spam). Your phone number is never saved publicly.
termsTier3: Higher Trust / Verified Reports — Highest level. Your media gets a digital fingerprint on your device, private details are removed, and stronger protection is applied.
termsSection4Intro: You stay in control of your voice. Here are the clear rules:
termsConduct1: Your Choice: You decide whether to speak publicly or stay more private.
termsConduct2: Be Honest: Only post reports and evidence you genuinely believe are true.
termsConduct3: No Doxxing or Harassment: Do not share other people’s private details. Targeted harassment is not allowed.
termsConduct4: No Fake or Harmful Content: Creating deepfakes to harm someone is strictly forbidden.
termsSection5Text: You keep ownership of what you post. By publishing, you give VocalWitness permission to store and display it. Published content is protected against ordinary user edits or deletes by security rules. It is not a public blockchain; the data lives on Firebase.
termsSection6Text: We use trusted global services for secure storage and protection against attacks. The platform is provided “as is”.
termsSection7Text: The platform is supported by voluntary donations. Donations do not give anyone special control or ownership.
termsSection8Text: To the fullest extent allowed by law, VocalWitness is not responsible for indirect damages arising from use of the platform or content posted by users.
termsSection9Title: 9. Your Responsibility for What You Post
termsSection9Text: You are responsible for what you publish. If someone has a problem with content, they should use our reporting process.
termsSection10Text: All rights in the VocalWitness platform, including its software, design, name, and logo, remain the exclusive property of VocalWitness.
termsSection10Text2: You may not copy, modify, or commercially exploit any part of the platform without written permission.

safetySection4Title: 4. How We Keep the Community Safe
safetySection4Text: Safety comes from community reporting and clear verification levels:
safetyModTier1: Open Talk — Open discussion for everyone.
safetyModTier2: Higher Trust — Stronger protection and reputation.
safetyGoalText: A safe public square where real reports can be shared and people are protected by design.
threatModelDesc: VocalWitness strips EXIF metadata in the browser and offers optional higher-trust verification. Technology alone cannot prevent all exposure. For high-risk reporting, use extra operational security.
networkTip1: Use Tor or a Trustworthy VPN: Hide your physical location and IP address from network eavesdroppers before navigating to VocalWitness.
networkTip2: Avoid Public Personal Wi-Fi: Do not upload sensitive whistleblower materials over home broadband or personal mobile accounts registered directly to your government ID.
mediaTip1: Automated Scrubbing: VocalWitness strips EXIF metadata (camera model, GPS coordinates) locally in your browser. However, check your background visually for identifying reflections, unique street signs, or private documents.
mediaTip2: Voice & Face Anonymization: When recording video or audio in hostile environments, blur faces of non-consenting bystanders and alter distinct voice patterns before publishing.
identityTip1: Pseudonymous Handle: Choose a username completely unlinked to your real name, social handles, or personal email address.
identityTip2: Higher-Trust Verification: Prefer stronger verification options when available. Some paths use real zero-knowledge proofs; others use simpler cryptographic checks — check the badge on each report.
physicalTip1: Secure Device Storage: Keep your mobile phone encrypted and passcoded (avoid biometrics like fingerprint/face unlock in regions where authorities can compel biometric unlock).
physicalTip2: Clear Browser Data: If using a shared or at-risk device, clear local storage and browser cache immediately after submitting your record.
goldenRuleTitle: The Golden Rule of Citizen Witnessing
goldenRuleText: Never put yourself in immediate physical danger to capture evidence. Secure your safety first. Then use the tools available to timestamp and share a verifiable record.
ledgerIntegrityPara1: Once a report is published, the rules make it extremely hard for ordinary users to edit or delete the original.
ledgerIntegrityPoint1: Database rules block ordinary updates and deletes on the sealed record.
ledgerIntegrityPoint2: Digital fingerprints are created on your device.
ledgerIntegrityPoint3: Records are linked together for extra protection.
ledgerIntegrityClarification: Important: This is strong application-level protection, not a full public blockchain. The data lives in secure cloud storage (Firebase).
ledgerIntegrityFuture: Future option: We may add extra public anchoring. This is not yet active.

howToUseSubtitle: A complete guide to speaking out, sealing evidence, and verifying the public record.
howToUseIntro: VocalWitness is a privacy-first public square for citizen reporting. Anyone can share what they witnessed or join live discussions. Once a report is published, its media and cryptographic seal are protected against secret edits or hard deletion.
howStep1Intro: VocalWitness separates open community discussion from high-integrity first-hand reporting so readers know what kind of record they are viewing:
howCitizenTalkCardDesc: Open to all signed-in citizens for everyday reports, community updates, questions, and civic discussion. Every post is still hashed and sealed.
howWitnessVoiceCardDesc: Reserved for direct, first-hand observations and verifiable evidence. Media is fingerprinted on your device before upload for stronger verification.
howStep2Item1: Sign in with Google, GitHub, or X (no government ID or passport is ever collected).
howStep2Item2: Open the composer in the Public Square and choose Citizen Report or Field Note (if posting in a professional capacity like Researcher, NGO, or Educator).
howStep2Item3: Write what you saw or experienced clearly, and add an optional short headline.
howStep2Item4: Attach Live Voice, a Photo, a short raw Video, or an Audio file if you have supporting evidence.
howStep2Item5: Choose whether to post publicly or restrict visibility to your Trusted Circle, then tap Publish Report.
howWhatHappens1: • Location (GPS) and camera metadata are automatically stripped in your browser.
howWhatHappens2: • A SHA-256 digital fingerprint is created and sealed into the public record.
howWhatHappens3: • You have 30 minutes to fix typos in the text only. Media and hashes can never be altered.
howWhatHappens4: • After 30 minutes, you can soft-hide a report from the main feed, but the sealed record cannot be secretly erased.
howStep3Title: 3. Record Live Voice & Witness Voice Reports
howStep3Intro: Use Witness Voice when you are directly witnessing an event and want the strongest level of integrity.
howStep3Item1: Switch to the Witness tab or select Witness Voice as your destination channel.
howStep3Item2: Tap Live Voice to record directly on the spot—live audio carries stronger weight as first-hand evidence than uploaded files.
howStep3Item3: Attach unedited photos or short raw video clips (AI-generated or heavily edited videos are strictly prohibited).
howStep3Item4: Review your preview and publish once to lock the cryptographic seal.
howStep4Item1: Right after publishing (or from any sealed report), click Download Evidence Pack.
howStep4Item2: Save the JSON file—it contains your report ID, timestamp, text hash, media hashes, and verification instructions.
howStep4Item3: Share the report link or Evidence Pack JSON with journalists, human rights groups, researchers, or your community.
howStep4Note: No account is required to inspect or verify an Evidence Pack.
howStep5Title: 5. Verify Any Report or Media File
howVerifyOnlineDesc: Open the shared report link or visit the Evidence Verifier page. You can check a Testimony or Credential ID against the ledger, scan a media file for Content Credentials (C2PA), or paste an Evidence Pack JSON to confirm nothing was altered.
howVerifyOfflineDesc: Compute the SHA-256 hash of the original media file or text on any computer and compare it against the hash inside the Evidence Pack. Identical hashes prove the file has not changed by a single bit since sealing.
howStep6Title: 6. Live Arena, My Circle & Trust Tiers
howStep6Item1: Live Arena: Join or host real-time audio rooms for breaking local events, traffic, weather, or civic updates, filtered by Near Me, My Circle, or Higher Trust.
howStep6Item2: My Circle: Follow reliable reporters and build a Trusted Circle so you can share sensitive updates only with people you trust.
howStep6Item3: Verification Tiers: Everyone starts as a Citizen. Complete a temporary anti-spam phone check (never stored publicly) to unlock Citizen Circle, or complete Higher Trust verification for Witness Circle features.
howStep6Item4: Groups & Corroboration: Join topic or community groups and corroborate reports you independently witnessed to strengthen public context.
howStep7Item1: Privacy Shield: Keep Privacy Shield enabled in Edit Profile to hide your real name and region from public view.
howStep7Item2: Data Saver Mode: Toggle Data Saver in the top menu or footer to reduce bandwidth and mobile data usage on slow connections.
howStep7Item3: Emergency Clear: In Security & Account settings, use Emergency Clear This Device to instantly wipe local browser data on your phone or computer while keeping your sealed reports safe on the record.
howStep7Item4: Keep Your Evidence Packs: Store downloaded JSON packs in a safe folder or cloud backup as permanent, independent proof.

faqSubtitle: Clear answers about sealing, privacy, and verification.
faqQ1Body: A privacy-first public square where anyone can publish sealed citizen reports. Once sealed, ordinary users (including the author) cannot change the media, hashes, or core record. Text can only be corrected for 30 minutes. After that only soft-hide is allowed.
faqQ2Body: Media is cleaned and hashed on your device with SHA-256. The final uploaded bytes receive a digital fingerprint. Strict server rules protect the seal so ordinary users cannot break it.
faqQ2Strong: Sealed means the bits are protected. It does not mean the event is proven true.
faqQ3Title: Can I edit or delete my report later?
faqQ3Body: Text is editable for 30 minutes only. After that you can soft-hide the report (it disappears from normal feeds but stays in the sealed record). Hard delete of sealed evidence is not available to authors. This keeps the record verifiable.
faqQ4Title: Does the hash prove that the event really happened?
faqQ4Body: No. Hashes and Evidence Packs only prove that the digital file has not been changed after it was sealed. They do not prove that the real-world event occurred.
faqQ5Body: No. VocalWitness uses application-level sealing (client hashing + strict rules) plus optional daily public timestamping of the ledger root via OpenTimestamps. It is not a public blockchain.
faqQ6Title: What is the difference between Public Square and Witness Voice?
faqQ6PublicSquareDesc: open citizen reporting. Anyone can post.
faqQ6WitnessVoiceDesc: higher-integrity channel for first-hand observations. Media and text are hashed on-device with stronger sealing expectations.
faqQ7Title: What is Phone Verification / Citizen Circle / Witness Circle?
faqQ7Body: Phone verification raises your trust level (Citizen Circle) and helps reduce spam. Witness Circle (Higher Trust) is earned through platform checks and optional zero-knowledge membership proof. These tiers are never for sale.
faqQ8Title: Is my phone number made public?
faqQ8Body: No. Phone numbers are used only for anti-spam and trust scoring. They are not written onto the public sealed ledger as your identity.
faqQ9Title: How do journalists or NGOs verify evidence?

privacyIntro: VocalWitness is built with privacy as a core design principle. We collect only what is necessary to operate a public square for sealed citizen reports, and we give you clear control over what is visible.
privacySec1Intro: We process the following categories of information:
privacyCollectAccountDesc: email (via Google or other sign-in), optional display name, username, and profile photo you choose to upload.
privacyCollectPhoneDesc: only if you complete phone verification (Citizen Circle). Used solely for anti-spam and is not written onto the public sealed ledger as your identity.
privacyCollectContentDesc: text, photos, voice notes, and videos you choose to seal and post. Media can be hashed on your device before upload.
privacyCollectTechDesc: basic operational logs needed for security, abuse prevention, and service reliability (handled via Firebase and Cloudflare).
privacySec1Footer: We do not sell personal data. We do not use advertising trackers on sealed testimony.
privacyUse1: • To operate the public square, store sealed reports, and enable verification tools.
privacyUse2: • To prevent spam, bots, and abuse (including phone verification for higher tiers).
privacyUse3: • To provide optional features such as the Independent Citizen Press Credential.
privacyUse4: • To respond to legal requests when required by applicable law.
privacyUse5: We never use payment for a Press Credential or voluntary support to change your trust rank or voting power.
privacyFeat1Desc: Location and device metadata can be stripped in the browser before media is uploaded when privacy mode is active.
privacyFeat2Desc: You can hide your real name and location from public profile views while still participating.
privacyFeat3Desc: Media and text can be fingerprinted with SHA-256 on your device so others can verify integrity without trusting us blindly.
privacyFeat4Desc: Instantly clears local browser storage on this device and redirects away from the site.
privacyStorage1: Data is stored on Google Firebase and protected at the edge by Cloudflare. Operators retain administrative access necessary for moderation, security, and legal compliance.
privacyStorage2: Sealed public reports are designed to remain part of the permanent public record. Account-level data (email, phone verification status, etc.) is not published on the sealed ledger as your identity.
privacyStorage3: We do not sell your data to third parties for advertising.
privacyRights1: • You control what you publish and whether to enable Privacy Shield.
privacyRights2: • You can request account-related changes or deletion subject to legal and operational limits (sealed public records cannot be quietly erased by ordinary users).
privacyRights3: • You can clear local data on any device using Quick Exit.
privacyRights4: • For questions about your data, use the contact / support options on the main site.
privacySec6Body: VocalWitness is not directed at children under 13 (or the applicable age in your jurisdiction). We do not knowingly collect personal information from children.
privacySec7Body: We may update this Privacy Policy from time to time. The “Last updated” date at the top will change when we do. Continued use of the platform after changes constitutes acceptance of the revised policy.
privacySec8Body: For privacy-related questions, use the Support options available on the main VocalWitness site or the contact methods listed in the repository / about page.

termsSec2Heading: 2. Our Role – A Public Square Infrastructure
termsSec2Body: VocalWitness provides a structured interface for public reporting. We offer tools to publish reports and manage community interaction, operating on cloud infrastructure (Firebase) with moderation capabilities managed by operators and platform systems. We do not act as an editorial publisher of user content.
termsSec3Intro: To keep the square safe from bots and spam, we use tiered verification levels:
termsSec3Tier1Desc: Open to everyone who signs up for basic public discussion.
termsSec3Tier2Desc: Unlocked with a phone verification workflow to help prevent spam and bot accounts.
termsSec3Tier3Desc: Advanced tiers incorporating client-side media hashing, metadata processing, and optional zero-knowledge proofs.
termsSec3Note: Trust tiers and reputation are never for sale.
termsSec4Rule1Desc: You decide what content to publish within the public square.
termsSec4Rule2Desc: Only post reports and evidence you genuinely believe are accurate.
termsSec4Rule3Desc: Do not share other people’s private details. Targeted harassment is strictly prohibited.
termsSec4Rule4Desc: Creating deceptive or malicious media to harm others is forbidden.

safetyBannerDesc: Every individual has the right to record and publish verified accounts of public events. This framework is anchored to Article 19 of the Universal Declaration of Human Rights.

safetyPoint2Desc: Metadata and device signatures can be stripped in-browser before publishing.
safetyPoint3Desc: Information is stored securely via Firebase and Cloudflare with operational controls.
